delivered: application/visual_subagent.py: VISUAL_SUBAGENT ToolSpec (task/frame_object_id or frame_object_ids or frames_id/focus, writes=False), VisualModelFactory/media-frame source support, VisualSubagentCapabilities returning text plus frames/focus/model/cost/tokens with verification=visual_summary.

adapters/visual.py: ImageObjectFrames verifies agent-owned image objects through ObjectService.get + ImageService.prepare; MediaFrameSheets resolves a registered media frame sheet through MediaService.frames and reuses the same object/metadata checks; ModelCallsVisualModel sends 1..4 frames as in-run tool-result images to ModelCalls.invoke with tools=(), the run's budget/image policy, and no master history/tools; maps image budget to budget_exceeded and protocol/source/model failures to explicit errors.

application/visual_subagent.py: operation_id joins the action ledger; a second visual call in the same parent run is rejected (visual_unavailable) before frame resolution/model dispatch, matching D2's one-call-per-run rule.

composition/instance.py: constructs VisualSubagentService/ImageObjectFrames/MediaFrameSheets/ModelCallsVisualModelFactory, owns/closes it, registers the visual_subagent capability and exposes health. No migration, table, route or capability-schema change.
